svg.title: Seven music source-separation architectures
svg.desc: Spleeter uses per-stem magnitude U-Nets and mixture-phase ratio masks in this port. Open-Unmix uses per-target BiLSTMs and multichannel Wiener filtering. HTDemucs joins spectral and waveform paths with a cross-domain Transformer and sums decoded waveforms. MDX23C uses channel-wise subbands and a TFC-TDF U-Net to estimate complex spectra. BS-RoFormer predicts complex masks from disjoint bands with time and band attention. Mel-Band RoFormer uses overlapping bands and averages overlapping masks. SCNet combines unequal band compression, dual-path recurrent processing and a sparse decoder. These are simplified inference paths, not a quality ranking. Sources are in the companion guide.
svg.title: Music source-separation architecture comparison
